content: The test image shows a corn ear with pink/reddish-salmon colored kernels and visible mold. This looks like an ear rot disease. The pink-to-red coloration on kernels strongly suggests Gibberella ear rot.

The reference Gibberella image shows white mold from tip rot. The test image shows pink/reddish-salmon kernel discoloration with some mold — this pink-to-red pigmentation on kernels is a hallmark of Gibberella ear rot (Fusarium graminearum). The reference shows an earlier/different presentation, but the pink kernel discoloration strongly points to Gibberella.
